'''Orailus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], while in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Devron]] came to him to be healed after he and his team were attack by grave robbers in one of the tombs. Orailus warned him that if anything valuable was gone, Devron would regret it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
